title: aster ciliatus subsp. laurentianus
intro: Aster ciliatus subsp. laurentianus, commonly known as Laurentian aster, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to eastern North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that may aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Laurentian aster are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions, including infections, inflammation, and oxidative stress.
